summary_for_agent: Customer reports a failed UPI payment of ₹9,500 debited from HDFC account four days ago with no credit to merchant. They want the full amount reversed today. Transaction status is DEBITED_NOT_CREDITED with failure reason BANK_SWITCH_TIMEOUT. The transaction is 3 days past RBI T+1 deadline, so ₹300 compensation is auto-due. Since the auto-refund limit is ₹5,000 and the amount is ₹9,500, human approval is required for the full reversal.
